item.title: Invex says unaware of cause behind FIDEAL 20’s 20.45% price drop on unusual trading
item.description: Banco Invex, as trustee of trust F/3935, issued a clarification on unusual trading in FIDEAL 20 CBEFs on Aug. 27, 2026. The securities posted a -20.45% move
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Banco Invex, as trustee of trust F/3935, issued a clarification on unusual trading in FIDEAL 20 CBEFs on Aug. 27, 2026. The securities posted a -20.45% move in the traded price during the session. No known cause identified for the move following an information-gathering review under applicable market rules. The trustee reported no committee member trading or use of the buyback fund linked to the price swing. Any additional findings from a deeper review will be disclosed through the same channel.
